violations.msg: The Rset selection network has no interlock forcing exactly one of R5/JP1/JP2/JP3 closed: zero closed leaves CFG1 floating with no documented internal pull (undefined single-resistor-mode detection), and two closed puts two Rset resistors in parallel (e.g. R5+JP2 = 24k||56k = 16.9k), which is not a table 5-1 value and requests an unpredictable voltage; both states are reachable by an ordinary rework mistake (desolder R5 before bridging the new jumper) and are invisible to ERC/netlist_audit since both are electrically legal.

No TVS, fuse or bulk cap beyond the 1 uF at VHV means nothing clamps connector hot-plug ringing at a 20 V PD contract before it reaches U1's VHV pin (32 V abs max, only ~12 V headroom at 20 V nominal); already an accepted, recorded risk (decision D4), re-flagged here only because it is the one plausible way this board damages hardware at 20 V.
